items.period: Modern vector redraw of a Lesser Seal script form; source form is the Shuowen Jiezi seal-script tradition
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of the seal-script 言 radical, shown as the speech-related element in traditional 誰.
items.alt: A black seal-script character form for 言 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The file description identifies the graph and seal-script style; its stated source is the Shuowen radical tradition. It can illustrate the traditional semantic element, but is not evidence for the bronze form or a photograph of an artifact.

items.period: Modern vector redraw of a Lesser Seal script form; source form is the Shuowen seal-script tradition
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of seal-script 隹, the element treated as phonetic in the traditional analysis of 誰; the ancient sound comparison remains uncertain.
items.alt: A black seal-script character form for 隹 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the character and script style, links the original SVG, and states public-domain reuse for this representation. It illustrates the component graph but does not establish the bronze form or its ancient sound history.
items.rights: Public domain release stated on the Commons file description page.

limitations.text: No verified image of the relevant bronze 誰 / bare-隹 inscription was established. The two selected component images are modern vector redrawings of seal-script forms and do not document the disputed bronze shape or its chronology.
